mr_title: Change __getstate__ and __setstate__ to use a dict

expected_issues.title: __setstate__ no longer accepts tuple state from older pickles
expected_issues.description:
__setstate__ now only accepts a dict, so instances pickled by earlier attrs versions (whose state is a tuple) can unpickle with missing attributes or fail with TypeError.

Slotted attrs classes previously pickled their state as a tuple of values. The new __setstate__ checks `name in state` for each attribute; for an old tuple state this membership test is against values, so attributes whose names are absent from the values are not restored. If a tuple value equals an attribute name, state[name] instead raises TypeError because tuple indices must be integers. Persisted pickles (caches, queues) break on upgrade; __setstate__ must keep accepting the tuple format.
